task.title: Preview this documentation
task.shortdesc: This site is itself an docs project, in the site/ folder of the repository. Preview it to see the platform at work.

context.p: The project uses most of what it documents: conditional keys, reusable chunks, product-gated sections, a build-time DITAVAL, two PDF publications, a brand theme and context-sensitive help keys. Read its sources next to the rendered pages.

step.cmd: Preview it: pnpm opend preview site.
Switch Preview as between the readers in site/preview-contexts.yaml.

stepresult.p: The navigation changes with the reader. For example, self-hoster sees the self-hosting guides and no embedded-help section, while managed-customer sees the embedded-help section and no Docker or Railway runbooks.

result.p: A test in packages/cli/test/site.test.ts builds this project, requires zero problems, and renders every page and both publications for every preview reader, so the docs cannot silently break.
